name: Dead bug
directions: DEAD BUG exercise, six frames3x2. Oblique TOP FRONT view of supine man, head LEFT, feetRIGHT, chest faces ceiling. CRITICAL CONTRALATERAL PAIR: the ARM NEAREST THE VIEWER stretches OVERHEAD toward LEFT while the LEG FARTHEST FROM VIEWER stretches LONG toward RIGHT floor; the NEAREST LEG stays BENT90degrees UP and FARTHEST ARM stays POINTING UP to ceiling. NEVER stretch nearest arm and nearest leg together. Frame1 both knees90 and armsup; frame2 begin contralateralextension as above; frame3 longneararm/farleg, nearlegbent/fararmup; frame4 sameextendedpair; frame5 returnpair; frame6 originalposition. Clearly show TWO arms and TWO legs without overlap so the crossed pair is obvious. Back pelvis head supported on floor, no arch.
